verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can create PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images and videos in a sandboxed VM with a persistent file workspace. Reusing a `thread_id` continues the same session, which supports iterative refinement of those files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exporting or downloading the generated files, explicit description of the edit-in-place workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of document and presentation quality.
